metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2025 · Adolescence
metas.description: When a 13-year-old is accused of the murder of a classmate, his family, therapist and the detective in charge are all left asking what really happened.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2024 · The Gentlemen
metas.description: When aristocratic Eddie inherits the family estate, he discovers that it's home to a huge weed empire, and its proprietors aren't going anywhere.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2024 · The Day of the Jackal
metas.description: The Jackal is an elusive assassin who makes his living carrying out hits for the highest fee. He soon meets his match in a tenacious British intelligence officer who tracks him down in a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase across Europe.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2025 · Dept. Q
metas.description: Carl, a former top-rated detective, is wracked with guilt following an attack that left his partner paralyzed and another policeman dead. On his return to work, Carl is assigned to a cold case that will consume his life.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · Legends
metas.description: Customs agents go undercover to infiltrate Britain's most dangerous drug gangs, following a thrilling criminal investigation based on extensive research and interviews with those involved in the top-secret operation.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2024 · Ludwig
metas.description: While seeking to unravel the mystery of his twin brother's disappearance, reclusive puzzle-designer John 'Ludwig' Taylor takes on his twin brother James's identity as DCI on Cambridge's major crimes squad.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2023 · Blue Lights
metas.description: Follows rookie police officers working in Belfast, a city in which being a frontline response cop comes with unique pressures and dangers.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2022 · The Responder
metas.description: A crisis-stricken, morally-compromised first-responder tackles a series of night shifts on the beat in Liverpool.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2022 · Karen Pirie
metas.description: When a historic murder case in St Andrews becomes the subject of a true crime podcast, fearless DS Karen Pirie is tasked with solving it.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2023 · The Long Shadow
metas.description: Dramatizing one of the most infamously notorious serial killer cases, the hunt for the Yorkshire Ripper, between 1975 and 1981. The search involved over a thousand officers and changed the way the British police worked forever.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2025 · This City Is Ours: A Crime Family Saga
metas.description: Michael, a longtime member of organized crime, falls in love with Diana, prompting him to reevaluate his life and contemplate a future beyond his criminal activities. His newfound love becomes both a motivation and a potential lia...

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2022 · Magpie Murders
metas.description: Editor Susan Ryeland gets drawn into a web of intrigue and murder when she receives Alan Conway's unfinished manuscript of an Atticus Pünd mystery.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Patience
metas.description: Patience catalogues evidence in the Yorkshire Police records department. A brilliant self-taught criminologist with keen crime scene instincts, her talent is spotted by Metcalf, opening new worlds for the archivist.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2023 · The Sixth Commandment
metas.description: Follows the deaths of Peter Farquhar and Ann Moore-Martin in the village of Maids Moreton, Buckinghamshire, and the extraordinary events that unfolded in the following years.
